meta.name: alert-manager
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "set SEO alerts" or "排名掉了提醒我"; configures threshold notifications for FUTURE ranking, traffic, technical, and competitor changes. Not for one-time measurement or reporting — use rank-tracker or performance-reporter. SEO预警/排名监控

copy.tagline: 设置排名与流量阈值预警，自动监控SEO变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望当网站排名或流量出现异常时能及时收到通知
copy.tagline_en: Set threshold alerts for ranking, traffic, and SEO changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to be notified when your site's ranking or traffic deviates from set thresholds

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设置 SEO 监控预警，当排名、流量、技术问题等指标超过你设定的阈值时，主动通知你。
howto.when: 当你要求“设置 SEO 预警”或“排名掉了提醒我”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置排名下降预警，监控前20个关键词。
say.note: Claude 会要求提供域名和阈值偏好。

say.text: 设置流量下降预警，周环比降幅超过15%就提醒。
say.note: Claude 会配置预警规则和通知方式。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you set up SEO monitoring alerts that notify you when rankings, traffic, technical issues, or other metrics exceed your defined thresholds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "set SEO alerts" or "remind me if rankings drop".

say_en.text: Set up ranking drop alerts for my top 20 keywords.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for domain and threshold preferences.

say_en.text: Set up traffic drop alerts, notify me if weekly drop exceeds 15%.
say_en.note: Claude will configure alert rules and delivery.
